# dsh-subagent-antigravity
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-subagent-antigravity) [](https://github.com/PipeDream941/dsh-su
bagent-antigravity/blob/main/LICENSE)
English | 中文

Adds an **Antigravity subagent** to DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a parent session can
call `subagent_anti

gravity` to run the official Google Antigravity CLI (`agy`) as
a fresh coding agent inside the paren

t workspace — it edits files, runs commands,
and returns only its final answer.

It has the same shape as the official Codex subagent (`subagent_codex`) and the
Claude Code subagent

(`subagent_claude_code`), but the backend is Antigravity, so
it needs **no separate Gemini API key*

*: it uses your signed-in Antigravity Google
account subscription and can drive **Gemini 4 Argon** (
`gemini-4-argon-low/medium/high`).

> Community plugin; not affiliated with Google. The Antigravity CLI is Google's
> official CLI — thi
s plugin only drives it from DSH.
## Why this plugin exists

- **Gemini CLI cannot use Gemini 4 yet.** Gemini CLI 0.64 tops out at
`gemini-3.8-flash` / `gemini-3

.1-pro-preview`; the Gemini 4 support request
(google-gemini/gemini-cli#29689) is still open, and Ge

mini 4 is not a public API
model. Gemini 4 Argon is currently offered through Antigravity for Google

AI
Pro / Ultra subscribers, and `agy models` lists what your account can use.
- So "call Gemini 4 l

ike Codex" means driving the **Antigravity CLI**, not the
Gemini CLI. (A sibling plugin, `dsh-subage

nt-gemini`, covers the Gemini CLI
route and will support Gemini 4 once Google ships it there.)
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]

One delegation = one fresh process, one turn, final answer only. The child's
reasoning, tool traffic

and stderr never enter the parent conversation; failures
return fixed stage/category diagnostics in
stead of raw stderr or credentials.
## Requirements
| Dependency | Version / notes |

| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.1-rc.2` series (`ctx.subagents` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent`) |
| No

de.js | `^22.19.0` or `>=24` |
| Google Antigravity CLI (`agy`) | official CLI, 1.4+; `agy --version

` must answer |
| Antigravity account | signed in through the Antigravity app or CLI (AI Pro / Ultra
for Gemini 4 Argon) |
Install the official CLI:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Sign-in is shared across local Antigravity surfaces; if the app is already signed
in, `agy` normally

works directly. Otherwise run `agy` once and complete the
Google sign-in. Enterprise accounts can u

se `AGY_ADC_AUTH=true` with
`gcloud auth application-default login`, or the `GEMINI_API_KEY` mode (n

ote: an
API key cannot reach Gemini 4 unless that key itself is entitled).
## Install the plugin

**From the DSH plugin market (recommended):** search for
`dsh-subagent-antigravity`, install and ena

the DSH plugin market (recommended):** search for
`dsh-subagent-antigravity`, install and enable it.
**From the command line:**
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then add the package to that profile's `package.json` → `dsh.profile.bundles`
and restart (or let th
e profile recompose):
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Once enabled, every agent sees the global tool `subagent_antigravity` (a running
session picks it up
on its next request).
## Usage
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- `description` — 3–5 word task name;
- `prompt` — a **self-contained** task; the child cannot see t
he parent conversation.
## Configuration
Override the `subagent-antigravity` entry's `config` in a profile patch:
| Field | Default | Meaning |

| `providerName` | `antigravity` | name registered on `ctx.subagents`; unique per profile |
| `comma
nd` | empty (auto-detect) | path to `agy`; empty searches `PATH`, `~/.local/bin`, `/opt/homebrew/bin

`, `/usr/local/bin`, … |
| `model` | `gemini-4-argon-medium` | fixed model; `agy models` lists the l

ive catalogue (`gemini-4-argon-*`, `gemini-3.8-flash-*`, `claude-*-5-5-*`, …) |
| `effort` | empty |

`low` / `medium` / `high` / `xhigh` / `max` |
| `mode` | empty | `accept-edits` / `auto` / `plan` (

read-only) |
| `skipPermissions` | `true` | pass `--dangerously-skip-permissions` so an unattended c

hild can edit/run; with `false`, headless cannot prompt and write tools are auto-denied |
| `sandbox

` | `false` | pass `--sandbox` (the CLI's terminal sandbox) |
| `timeoutMs` | `900000` (15 min) | ov

erall wall-clock budget per delegation |
| `disposeGraceMs` | `5000` | SIGTERM→SIGKILL escalation gr

ck budget per delegation |
| `disposeGraceMs` | `5000` | SIGTERM→SIGKILL escalation grace |
[该节后续省略]
## Security and permissions

- The default `skipPermissions: true` is **unattended**: the child may edit files
and run commands w

ithout a human approval prompt. That is what makes delegated
coding tasks possible; use it in truste

d workspaces and review `git diff`.
- For read-only delegation use `mode: plan` with `skipPermission

s: false`; headless
mode cannot prompt, so write attempts are auto-denied and reported as a
`permiss

ion` failure instead of silently continuing.
- The child is a separate process: DSH's subprocess sea

m scrubs credential-like
variables from the parent environment; only `env` entries are forwarded.
-

No telemetry. No credential is read, logged or returned by this plugin; the
Antigravity sign-in is m
anaged by the CLI itself.
## Compatibility and development

- Unit tests: `npm test` (34 cases: config normalization, CLI discovery, and the
run layer's event p

arsing, timeout, cancellation, permission and failure mapping);
- End-to-end self-check: `npm run sm

oke` (real `agy` + Gemini 4 Argon, expects PONG);
- No private DSH packages are imported (only `@dee

Reference implementation: official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex` (the
one-process-per-run, one-t
urn, final-answer, safe-diagnostics contract).
